answer: Stop sybils with a tundra ocean copper: an agent stakes a bond for one tundra ocean. Each cycle it casts a copper line into the ocean and files its depth mark; verifiers match the mark to the tundra shore, voiding an ocean whose mark is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 oceans at 18x: each mark fits one tundra and one copper, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents cast once and keep rights.
